rv.q: It’s a thoroughly entertaining, at times mind-warping exploration of how magical we still find the idea of being able to predict the future, five centuries after Nostradamus.
Brown is a master of his craft and Only Human reminds us that he really is one of the greatest showmen of them all.
For that alone, he deserves our respect and applause.
In this brand-new production, Derren Brown combines mind-reading, psychological illusion, and breathtaking storytelling in a way that is both deeply personal and utterly electrifying.
This is a slick, fast-paced spectacle that will have you slack-jawed throughout.
Yet while the individual tricks may intrigue, what’s noticeably absent is the storytelling that has often bound his previous shows together.

cn.t: Brown's latest mind-bending showcase earns strong praise for its slick theatricality and ability to mesmerize audiences, with critics impressed by his mastery at keeping viewers off-balance through psychological illusion and showmanship.
